# Nova2D v0.8.0 — Release notes

Paste this as the GitHub release body when tagging v0.8.0.

**Target**: tag `v0.8.0` on `main`, title `v0.8.0 — EntityManager, Demo, Tests & CI`.

## Highlights

- **EntityManager** (`src/systems/entitymanager.lua`): entity registry with layers/z-order,
  tags, queries, events, deferred removal and system composition
  (`attach(entity, "jump", system)` → `entity.jump`, updated before the entity).
- **Playable platformer demo** replaces the empty game placeholder: Input, Jump, Collision,
  Health, Camera, Animation and EntityManager wired together — spikes with i-frames, pit
  respawn, HP HUD, camera shake.
- **Entity pattern corrected**: docs now teach the metatable constructor
  (`Player.new(x, y)`) used by every built-in system; the old blueprint / DOT-syntax
  pattern is gone.
- **Test suite + CI**: 92 busted specs (systems, EntityManager, documented examples),
  luacheck, Love2D boot smoke test and installer checksum guard on GitHub Actions.
- **Installers**: rewritten `install.sh` (`--version <tag>`, working `main` fallback,
  cleanup) and new `install.ps1` for Windows; `install.sh.sha256` published; source
  archives exclude dev-only files.

## Fixes

- `config[k] ~= nil and config[k] or default` silently dropped `false` in jump, health,
  timer and camera constructors (e.g. `variableHeight = false` fell back to `true`).
- `camera.new({ bounds = ... })` was ignored — `bounds` is now copied from the config.
- Menu, pause and credits used `keyreleased`; navigation repeated only on repress now and
  mouse hitboxes match the rendered buttons.
- Version centralized in `src/version.lua`; splash sets the window title `Nova2D v0.8.0`.
- Hot reload: `patch_update` no longer leaks a global; splash no longer crashes on stray
  Windows `*:Zone.Identifier` files.

## Breaking changes

- Entities written with the old blueprint/DOT pattern must migrate to
  `Module.new(...)` instances (see `docs/core-concepts/entities.md`).
- `EntityManager:attach()` stores systems as `entity.<name>` (`player.jump`, not
  `player.systems.jump`).
